messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Following your letter on firm, long-term commitments, we offer a binding commitment for 23400 pieces per year over 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached term sheets.

Our should-cost estimate cost:340010 puts the unit cost at EUR 24.31, before margin. Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 79.5%, so we need a confirmed lead time of 42 days. Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, which makes this commitment a reliable base load for your capacity planning.

As the price change exceeds 2%, could you put this to your pricing committee? Please also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your should-cost estimate does not reflect the realities of our specialized production. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can accept the 24-month commitment for 23,400 units, provided the lead time is set to 56 days to ensure stable supply. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Based on this configuration, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. Specifically, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010 – 23400 pc/year commitment, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for accepting our 24-month commitment for 23400 pieces per year. We can extend it to 36 months, which gives you secure base load beyond the current contract. The attached term sheets cover 23400 pieces per year over 36 or 24 months.

We can accept the 56-day lead time in one package. For the others we would value your standard 42 days, as our production plans on that basis.

The price change exceeds 2%, so could you put these packages to your pricing committee at its next meeting? Please also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the seal is available.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010 – 23400 pc/year commitment, request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract and can offer a revised price of EUR 31.60 per unit for a volume of 23400 pieces per year with a 56-day lead time. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please provide the underlying data to substantiate your claim regarding the secure base load. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our offer details remain a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
